text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of greasy yellow scales in a 3-month-old infant is classic for infantile seborrheic dermatitis, often called cradle cap. To confirm this and rule out other conditions like eczema or psoriasis, I need to know: is the rash strictly confined to areas with high sebaceous gland activity (scalp, eyebrows, behind ears), and is the infant otherwise happy and feeding well?
